notes: Full text read at https://www.researchgate.net/publication/381296609_Generative_Lattice_Units_with_3D_Diffusion_for_Inverse_Design_GLU3D . Introduction discusses topology optimization as motivation, but Sections 3-4 evaluate diffusion-generated lattices against conventional simple-cubic and body-centered-cubic unit-cell geometries and test desired versus obtained stiffness. No classical topology or homogenization-based optimization run, result, or timing is compared.
